description: Foundation for vnode codegen. Add a Filament.VNodeEngine subengine that implements the EEx engine callbacks plus structured tag-open/tag-close callbacks. Teach Filament.TagEngine to call structured tag callbacks on the subengine for HTML elements, alongside (or in place of) the current handle_text("hello {y}' through VNodeEngine produces vnode AST equivalent to {:element, "div", [class: x_expr], [{:text, "hello "}, y_expr]} (or shape settled during impl). - Existing tests still pass via the wrapper-subengine fallback path. - New tests for VNodeEngine cover: static text, single expr, nested elements, void elements, attr expressions, boolean attrs.
title: Phase 1.4.1: VNodeEngine subengine + TagEngine structured callbacks
